rules.title: forwardRef has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: In React 20, forwardRef has been removed. Pass ref directly as a regular prop to function components.

remediation.summary: Remove forwardRef wrapper and receive ref directly in component props.

rules.title: <Context.Provider> has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: <Context.Provider> has been completely removed in React 20. Render <Context value={...}> directly.
rules.message:
`` has been removed in React 20. Render `` directly as a provider.
Before / After Example ```typescript // ❌ BEFORE // ✅ AFTER (React 20) ```

remediation.summary: Render the Context object directly instead of using .Provider.

rules.title: defaultProps on function components has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: Defining defaultProps on function components has been completely removed. Use JavaScript default parameter values in component argument lists.

remediation.summary: Replace defaultProps with ES6 default parameter destructuring in component arguments.

rules.title: Legacy Context API (contextTypes, childContextTypes) has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: The legacy Context API using contextTypes and childContextTypes has been completely removed in React 20. Use React.createContext() and the use() hook.

remediation.summary: Migrate legacy contextTypes to React.createContext() and the use(Context) hook.

rules.title: react-dom/test-utils package has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: react-dom/test-utils has been completely removed in React 20. Migrate unit tests to @testing-library/react and import act from 'react'.

remediation.summary: Import act directly from 'react' and migrate unit tests to React Testing Library.

rules.title: react-test-renderer package has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: react-test-renderer has been completely removed in React 20. Migrate your tests to @testing-library/react.

rules.title: useFormState has been completely removed from 'react-dom' in React 20
rules.description: useFormState from 'react-dom' has been completely removed in React 20. Use useActionState from 'react'.

remediation.summary: Replace useFormState from 'react-dom' with useActionState from 'react'.

rules.title: ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been completely removed in React 20
rules.description: ReactDOM.findDOMNode is completely removed in React 20. Use standard DOM refs.

remediation.summary: Pass a DOM ref directly to the native element instead of calling ReactDOM.findDOMNode.
